stories.name: Forest
stories.text: Trees have broken through a collapsed plaza and closed over it like a roof. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.

stories.name: Centaur's Herald
stories.intro: A centaur herald clears the road ahead of a Selesnya procession. This far from Vitu-Ghazi, the crowd will not part for him. He decides you are the crowd.
stories.win: The herald sounds his horn for you and promises a larger friend when you need one. He is yours now.
stories.lose: His hooves send you sprawling into the gutter.
stories.flee: You let the procession pass and slip off the other way.

stories.name: Giant Growth
stories.title: A spontaneous giant
stories.text: A Gruul shaman has sprinkled growth seed on a sleeping street cat. The cat is now the size of a cart and getting larger. An Azorius clerk is reading out the edict against tossing citizens.

choices.text: Grab the pouch of growth seed

outcome.text: You dart under the swelling cat toward the shaman.

huge_success.text: You snatch the pouch and a second one the shaman dropped.

success.text: The pouch is yours, and the cat shrinks back to size.

failure.text: The cat bats you across the square, and the shaman runs with the seed.

huge_failure.text: The shaman throws seed at a vine, and it pins you to a wall.

choices.text: Help the clerk serve the edict

outcome.text: The shaman pays the fine in seed, and the clerk lets you keep it.
You hear a clerk land in a fountain behind you.

stories.name: Drudge Beetle
stories.intro: A Golgari beetle the size of a dog hauls refuse from a cracked sewer grate. It is part of the Street Swarm, and you are standing on its route. It clacks its mandibles and charges.
stories.win: The beetle drops its load and falls in behind you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It knocks you flat and carries on with its work.
stories.flee: You step off its route, and it forgets you.

stories.name: Brushstrider
stories.intro: A long-legged brushstrider has wandered off its designated land. It has broken windows and eaten the blini-cakes from a baker's cart. It keeps one eye on you even as it charges.
stories.win: It crunches the last blini-cake and trots after you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It kicks you into the baker's flour sacks.
stories.flee: You leave the baker to deal with it.

stories.name: Savage Surge
stories.title: Where the battle is
stories.text: A Gruul warrior sits slumped against a wall, spent after a brawl. A Gruul shaman stands over him, hands glowing with a surge of wild strength. She needs someone to show the warrior where the next fight is.

outcome.text: The warrior surges to his feet, and the shaman teaches you the spell.

choices.text: Ask the shaman to cast it on you

outcome.text: Wild strength floods your limbs, and then the spell is yours.
You leave them to find their own fight.

stories.name: Aerial Predation
stories.title: The Samok Stand
stories.text: Between the towering trees of the Samok Stand, a vine lashes up and pulls a gargoyle out of the air. Something in the canopy is hunting anything with wings. A drake circles low over your head.

choices.text: Lure the drake toward the vines

outcome.text: You wave the drake down and run for the trees.

huge_success.text: The vines take the drake, and their sap heals your scrapes. The spell grows into your hand.

success.text: The vines snap shut on the drake, and you learn the spell that guides them.

failure.text: The drake rakes you before the vines catch it, and the spell fades.

choices.text: Ask the Stand's guardian to teach you

outcome.text: The guardian shows you how the trees choose their prey.

choices.text: Hurry out from under the drake

outcome.text: You leave the trees to their hunting.

stories.name: Korozda Monitor
stories.intro: A scaled monitor lizard slides out of the Korozda swamps, trailing moss. It hunts by barrelling through whatever stands in front of it. Right now, that is you.
stories.win: The monitor flicks its tongue at you and follows. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It ploughs through you and back into the mud.
stories.flee: You scramble up a drainpipe until it loses interest.

stories.name: Towering Indrik
stories.intro: A towering indrik chases a flock of pigeons down the avenue, rearing to snap them from the air. It pulverizes a fruit stall under its hooves. You are next under them.
stories.win: The indrik lowers its great head and lets you lead it. It is yours now.
stories.lose: Its hooves come down on you as it reaches for the pigeons.
stories.flee: You dodge into a doorway as it thunders past.

stories.name: Chorus of Might
stories.title: The strength of all of us
stories.text: A Selesnya chorus is singing in a sunlit courtyard. Each voice that joins makes the song stronger, until the flagstones hum. The cantor beckons you to sing.

outcome.text: Your voice joins theirs, and the cantor gives you the song to carry.

choices.text: Sing along without knowing the words

outcome.text: You open your mouth and hope.

huge_success.text: The chorus swells around your voice, and the cantor hands you the song.

success.text: You find the tune, and the song settles into you.

failure.text: The song falters, and the cantor politely asks you to go.

choices.text: Listen from the gate, then go

outcome.text: You leave the courtyard humming.

stories.name: Deadbridge Goliath
stories.intro: Under the Deadbridge, a beetle has been growing for centuries. It has not stopped. It unfolds from the shadow of the arch, wider than the bridge, and turns toward you.
stories.win: The goliath folds its legs and waits for your word. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It swats you into the black water under the bridge.
stories.flee: You run, and it settles back under the arch to keep growing.

stories.name: Rubbleback Rhino
stories.intro: A street urchin is riding a rhino through the market on a bet. Spells slide off its rubble-crusted back. It throws the urchin and comes for you.
stories.win: The rhino shrugs off the last of the rubble and follows you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It flings you after the urchin.
stories.flee: You leave the rhino to the next fool with a bet.

stories.name: Axebane Stag
stories.intro: A great stag steps out of the Axebane wilds, antlers wide as a gate. It waits for the city to fall so it can be king. Until then, it guards its ground from you.
stories.win: The stag bows its antlers and lets you walk beside it. It is yours now.
stories.lose: The antlers catch you and toss you into the hedge.
stories.flee: You back away, and the stag watches you go.

stories.name: Archweaver
stories.intro: A spider the size of a carriage hangs between two half-built Izzet towers. Its silk holds the scaffolds together. It drops on its thread and rushes at you.
stories.win: The archweaver spins a line to your shoulder and follows. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It wraps you in silk and hangs you from a girder.
stories.flee: You cut through a web and run for the street.

stories.name: Horncaller's Chant
stories.title: Gathering armies
stories.text: On a hill outside the district, a Selesnya horncaller is chanting. A rhino forms out of the grass, then a second rhino just like it. An Orzhov envoy watches from a carriage, taking notes.

choices.text: Ask the horncaller to teach you the chant

outcome.text: She teaches you the chant, and a rhino calf trots beside you as you go.

choices.text: Sell your account to the Orzhov envoy

outcome.text: The envoy pays well, but the horncaller sees, and her rhinos chase you off the hill.
The newest rhino lowers its horn at you.

stories.name: Death's Presence
stories.title: No flesh wasted
stories.text: In a Golgari rot farm, a shaman tends a bed of fungus over a fallen beast. Its strength seeps into the mushrooms around it. She offers you a share of what grows there.

outcome.text: She presses a spore-cap into your hand. Its strength is yours to pass on.

choices.text: Dig up the richest patch yourself

outcome.text: You kneel in the rot and start digging.

success.text: The fungus comes up whole, humming with borrowed strength.

failure.text: Spores fill your lungs, and the shaman chases you out.

huge_failure.text: The rot bed collapses into the undercity, and you climb out bruised and poorer.

choices.text: Leave the dead to the Golgari

outcome.text: You hold your breath until you reach the street.

stories.name: Axebane Guardian
stories.intro: A guardian of bark and moss stands at the edge of the Axebane, the forest that thinks. Only a worthy few may pass. It plants its feet and spreads its branches across the path.
stories.win: The guardian steps aside and walks beside you, humming with green mana. It is yours now.
stories.lose: Its branches sweep you back out of the forest.
stories.flee: You leave the forest's edge and the guardian to its watch.

stories.name: Druid's Deliverance
stories.title: The reed that bends
stories.text: Gruul raiders are pelting a Selesnya grove with stones, and every stone falls short. The druids sing as they work. They bend like reeds, they say, and they do not break.

outcome.text: The song settles in you, and the druids teach you its words.
You pick up a stone.

success.text: The raiders scatter, and the druids give you the song anyway.

failure.text: A stone catches you on the brow.

outcome.text: You leave the singing behind.

stories.name: Gatecreeper Vine
stories.intro: A vine has crept over a guildgate and grown thick as a wall. Every inch of Ravnica is home to something. This thing does not want you passing through its gate.
stories.win: The vine loosens and coils round your arm like a bracelet. It is yours now.
stories.lose: The vine wraps your legs and hangs you upside down until dusk.
stories.flee: You go round by another gate.

stories.name: Gobbling Ooze
stories.intro: An ooze has been loose in this district for a week. The rats are gone, and so are several carts. It slides toward you with a wet sound.
stories.win: The ooze settles and follows you like a hound. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It swallows your pack and spits out only the straps.
stories.flee: You climb a wall and wait for it to slide away.

stories.name: Golgari Decoy
stories.intro: A gaudy Golgari creature dances in the middle of the street, painted in every colour. Every creature nearby turns to look at it, and so do you. It comes at you while you stare.
stories.win: The decoy bows a deep, silly bow and follows you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: While you watch it, something else bites you from behind.
stories.flee: You tear your eyes away and run.

stories.name: Mana Bloom
stories.title: A flower that holds light
stories.text: A gardener in an abandoned plaza is tending a bloom that opens into light instead of petals. Each night it closes and gives off a little more mana. She says it will last as long as it is not plucked too often.

outcome.text: She cuts you a cutting of the bloom.
She wraps a cutting in damp moss.
You leave the bloom where it grows. Its light will heal you each time you come back.

stories.name: Oak Street Innkeeper
stories.intro: The innkeeper of Oak Street stands in her doorway with a ladle. Weary travellers are welcome, she says. Troublemakers get the ladle, and she has decided you are trouble.
stories.win: She laughs, puts the ladle down and offers you a room for life. She is yours now.
stories.lose: The ladle cracks across your knuckles.
stories.flee: You apologise and go on down Oak Street.

stories.name: Seek the Horizon
stories.title: A glimpse of the horizon
stories.text: From the top of an old spire you can see, for once, past the glass and stone to the horizon. A Selesnya wanderer sits there mapping the land beyond. She says the land itself will answer if you ask it.

outcome.text: You feel the plains and forests answer, and the rock beside you parts. She teaches you the asking.
She thanks you with her spell and a copy of the map.
You take a last look and climb down.

stories.name: Slime Molding
stories.title: An ooze from the refuse
stories.text: A Golgari shaman stirs a vat of refuse and mana. Give her enough, she says, and she will make an ooze to swallow the city. She is short of refuse today.

outcome.text: The ooze she makes is small and friendly, and she gives you the recipe.
She sells it with a grin.
You leave before it bubbles over.

stories.name: Stonefare Crocodile
stories.intro: A crocodile basks on an Izzet pipe in the undercity, and the pipe is no longer working. The Izzet's plans for the undercity met a few stubborn obstacles. This is one of them.
stories.win: The crocodile slides off the pipe and follows you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: Its jaws close on your boot, and you limp away barefoot.
stories.flee: You leave it to its pipe.

stories.name: Urban Burgeoning
stories.title: A wild garden in the ruins
stories.text: The ruins of Old Prahv have gone wild, and trees push through the old Senate floors. No birds sing here, quieted by old Azorius magic. Green mana wells up in every crack.

outcome.text: The cutting takes root in your pack, eager to grow.
You wake rested, with a seedling at your feet.
You leave the silent trees behind.

stories.name: Wild Beastmaster
stories.intro: A wild man leads a pack of beasts through the streets, and the citizens scatter. They covered the world in city, he shouts, and gave themselves nowhere to run. His beasts turn toward you.
stories.win: The beastmaster whistles his pack to heel and agrees to hunt with you. He is yours now.
stories.lose: His beasts run you down and leave you in the gutter.
stories.flee: You find a door to close behind you.

stories.name: Worldspine Wurm
stories.intro: The street shakes, and a wurm longer than the street itself rises from the undercity. It is older than the guilds. It does not look at you, but it is coming your way.
stories.win: The wurm stops, and its great eye turns to you. It will answer your call now.
stories.lose: The wurm passes over you, and you are lucky to be alive.
